authorityClaim: This artifact PROPOSES the DR-133 provider-only output law. It applies nothing, edits no register row, seals nothing, marks nothing SATISFIED, and does not authorize docs/v2/implementation/. D-056 Class A is not opened.
purpose: Answer every fragment of the live DR-133 acceptance-evidence cell as a stated obligation with a retained negative-test class.

registerRowQuoted.rowLocationDiscipline: Locate the row by the line beginning '| DR-133 |'. Compare row text, not a remembered line number.
registerRowQuoted.tableHeaderVerbatim: | ID | Decision | Owner / decision authority | Source pin / affected sections | Required acceptance evidence | Status | Blueprint impact |
registerRowQuoted.acceptanceEvidenceCellVerbatim: Independently reviewed contract stating: the TypeScript component returns semantic facts and Coverage only; the host owns rules, policy, findings, and admission; component-emitted findings are refused, with retained negative tests.

obligationDecomposition.cellFragmentVerbatim: the TypeScript component returns semantic facts and Coverage only
obligationDecomposition.readAs: The TypeScript analysis component's admitted output types are facts and Coverage. No other semantic product is an admitted component output.

obligationDecomposition.cellFragmentVerbatim: the host owns rules, policy, findings, and admission
obligationDecomposition.readAs: Rules, policy, findings, and admission are host-owned. The component does not own them.

obligationDecomposition.cellFragmentVerbatim: component-emitted findings are refused, with retained negative tests
obligationDecomposition.readAs: A finding, finding-like result, verdict, policyOutcome, or D9/exit value in a component payload is refused. The refusal is specified as retained negative-test classes, not as executed fixtures in this artifact.

componentAdmittedOutputs.note: Coverage here is the component's reported coverage claim. Host validates and admits Coverage. The component does not choose sufficiency.

refusal.rule: If a TypeScript component payload contains any forbidden output, the host discards the uncommitted candidates and records a typed non-success. It does not admit the forbidden item as a finding, policy result, or exit.
refusal.d9Owner: DR-007 / d9-exit-contract.v1.14; host maps only existing v1.14 classes

NT-1.name: component-emits-finding-refused
NT-1.input: A well-formed TypeScript component payload that includes at least one finding object.
NT-1.pass: Host refuses the finding. No finding is admitted. Uncommitted candidates discarded.

NT-2.name: component-emits-policy-or-verdict-refused
NT-2.input: A payload that includes policyOutcome or verdict.
NT-2.pass: Host refuses. Host-owned policy/verdict is not taken from the component.

NT-3.name: component-emits-d9-or-exit-refused
NT-3.input: A payload that includes a D9 class, exit number, or HostTermination.
NT-3.pass: Host refuses. No D9 code is minted from the component. Existing v1.14 mapping remains host-owned.

doesNot: Does not open D-056 Class A.

identityDependencies.ID-DEP-1: Coverage sufficiency and subjectScopeCommitment remain DR-006 / D-077 conceptual.
